mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_key, title, category, content, embedding, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, embedding_status, version_no, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_knowledge WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge SET embedding = #{embedding}, embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, embedding_dimensions = #{embeddingDimensions}, embedding_status = 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND embedding_status = 0
